title: 3% of Egypt's land, nearly three quarters of its city population
head: 3% of the land.
Nearly 3/4 of city dwellers.
tag: Full video: why most Egyptians live on a sliver of the map

thumb.small: measured from Natural Earth's map data

description: A strip 10 km either side of the Nile, plus the land between its delta branches, is 2.9% of Egypt's area. It holds 73% of the population in Natural Earth's list of Egyptian cities (metropolitan estimates, not a census). Computed cell by cell from public Natural Earth data. title: Egypt's Nile strip is smaller than Belgium
head: Egypt's Nile strip
is smaller than Belgium.
tag: Full video: why most Egyptians live on a sliver of the map

thumb.small: the strip where most Egyptians live

description: Within 10 km of the Nile, plus the land between its delta branches: about 29,200 km2, a little smaller than Belgium (about 30,600 km2 by Natural Earth outlines), inside a country about 33 times Belgium's size. In the valley near Luxor the towns sit inside that strip like beads on a string. From the full video on Contour Notes. #egypt #geography #maps
